title_zh: 约定整理驻外记者的采访往来邮件

scenario.label_zh: 约定整理驻外记者的采访往来邮件
scenario.goal_zh: 明确需要查找的采访确认邮件，并约定按对象和日期整理供记者出发前核对

context_zh: 新闻编辑室的同事整理一位驻外记者已有的工作邮件副本，不实际发送消息。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Our foreign correspondent leaves on Monday. Has the interview with the port manager been confirmed?

sentences.speaker: Editor
sentences.text: I saw a possible time in the correspondence, but I have not found a final acceptance.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Could you separate the invitation, the suggested times and any confirmation? I do not want a proposal to appear as a fixed appointment.

sentences.speaker: Editor
sentences.text: Yes. I'll organise the emails by contact and date and mark anything still waiting for a reply.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Thank you. We'll ask the reporter to check that list before treating any interview as booked.
